fields.name: Rādhāramaṇa Ghoṣa Bhāgavatabhūṣaṇa
fields.place: Kāgojīṭolā; Tripura (secretary of the king); Vṛndāvana
fields.guru: Mahārājā Vīracandra Māṇikya of Tripura (who showed him the path); a siddha Vaiṣṇava of Vṛndāvana (who told him to read the Bhāgavata to Kṛṣṇa)
fields.notes: Son of Kṛṣṇagovinda Ghoṣa; private secretary of Vīracandra Māṇikya of Tripura, who turned him to Vaiṣṇavism; saw Śyāmasundara come out of a tamāla tree in Vṛndāvana, and read the Bhāgavatam to Kṛṣṇa all his life. Helped Rāmanārāyaṇa Vidyāratna publish the Bengali Bhāgavatam with four commentaries and gave a lakh of rupees for its free distribution. Died of smallpox caught nursing a neighbour.

fields.name: Keśava Kāśmīrī (Digvijayī Paṇḍita)
fields.aka: Keśava Kāśmīrī (Or Digvijayī Paṇḍit), Digvijayī, Keśava Bhaṭṭa Kāśmīrī
fields.guru: Mukunda and Gaṅgala Bhaṭṭa (as he writes); in the Nimbārka line after Gokula Bhaṭṭa (Bhakti-ratnākara 12)
fields.works: Laghu-keśava, Vedānta-kaustubha-prabhā, Tattva-prakāśikā (Gītā commentary), Govinda-śaraṇāgati-stotra, Yamunā-stotra
fields.notes: A great paṇḍita of the Nimbārka sampradāya from Kashmir, the «Digvijayī», blessed by Sarasvatī; defeated in Navadvīpa by the young Nimāi Paṇḍita, he surrendered to Him (Caitanya-bhāgavata Ādi 13; Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 16). His line in the Bhakti-ratnākara 12.2243-2276.
